coverage_assessment: Open-web pass logged 23 Korean- and English-language queries, including weekly, sector, regional and Dec.–Feb. boundary searches. Five URLs were opened (including the Kyunghyang archive page, which did not verify the target article); eight remain search_only. Two documented congress-support rally leads were excluded because available contemporary reporting describes pledges to implement Party/state policy and no demand of the North Korean state; no attendance number was found. This is not evidence that January had no protests. Domestic archives and the original KCNA and Ministry of Unification sources remain uninspected.

temporary_resources.closure: No persistent temporary resources were started. One-shot foreground HTTPS retrieval processes exited; HTTP results and process exits are recorded in report.txt.
